metadata.description: Deployment stage: foundation, then migrate (run the migrate job and wait for success), then apps.
Immutable tag (git SHA) of nuvexa-backend. The migrate job, api and worker always run the same tag.
Immutable tag (git SHA) of nuvexa-frontend.
Azure region of the workload resources.
Tags applied to every resource.
Existing Azure Container Registry (admin user disabled) holding the images; pulled with the managed identity.
Resource group of the registry.
Subscription of the registry.
OpenTelemetry Collector (contrib distribution, azuremonitor exporter) image in the registry, as repository:tag@sha256:digest.
Existing Azure OpenAI account; the managed identity gets Cognitive Services OpenAI User on it.
Resource group of the Azure OpenAI account.
Subscription of the Azure OpenAI account.
Azure OpenAI deployment name (AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT).
Azure OpenAI GA API version with structured outputs (AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION), e.g. 2024-10-21 or newer.
User-assigned managed identity of the apps (frontend, api, worker, collector).
Separate user-assigned managed identity of the migrate job: the only principal that can read database-migrate-url.
Log Analytics workspace.
Application Insights component (traces, through the OpenTelemetry Collector).
Virtual network.
Container Apps environment.
Key Vault (globally unique, 3-24 characters).
PostgreSQL Flexible Server (globally unique).
Container app names. The frontend reaches the api at http://<apiAppName>.
Container Apps job that runs `nuvexa migrate`.
Address space of the virtual network.
Container Apps environment infrastructure subnet (workload profiles: /27 or larger).
Subnet delegated to PostgreSQL Flexible Server (private access).
Subnet for private endpoints (Key Vault).
Public host name of the dashboard (custom domain bound to the frontend app), without scheme.
Managed certificate of dashboardHost in the environment, once bound (docs/deployment.md). Empty: no custom domain yet. Set it on every later deployment, or the deployment removes the binding.
ENTRA_TENANT_ID: tenant of the app registration (a tenant id, or "organizations").
ENTRA_CLIENT_ID: application (client) id of the production app registration.
ENTRA_ALLOWED_TENANT_IDS: tenants allowed to sign in.
BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAILS: accounts made tenant administrator when first created. Clear after the first sign-in.
AZURE_DEVOPS_MODE. pat also wires the azure-devops-pat Key Vault secret.
AZURE_DEVOPS_ORGANIZATION.
AZURE_DEVOPS_DEFAULT_PROJECT.
MAIL_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS: 0 = manual sync only.
LOG_LEVEL.
DATABASE_POOL_SIZE per process (plus the same overflow). Keep pool x replicas under max_connections.
WORKER_CONCURRENCY: jobs per worker replica.
JOB_LEASE_SECONDS: keep it well above the longest job (LLM timeout x retries x steps).
DATABASE_RUNTIME_ROLE: the DML-only role of database-url. The migrate job grants it; api and worker check it at startup.
Key Vault public network access. Disabled: reachable only through the private endpoint.
Operator CIDRs allowed through the Key Vault firewall (used only when public network access is Enabled).
Soft-delete retention of the vault (days).
PostgreSQL server administrator login (password authentication). Never used by the application.
Administrator password: required when the server is created (or to rotate it); leave empty on later deployments.
Compute SKU (zone-redundant HA needs General Purpose or Memory Optimized).
High availability; zone-redundant for production.
Automated backup (point-in-time restore) retention in days.
Deploy the OpenTelemetry Collector and Application Insights and export traces (OTEL_ENABLED).
Zone-redundant Container Apps environment (region must support availability zones).
Encrypt traffic between apps inside the environment (peer-to-peer TLS), including http://<app-name> calls.
Worker termination grace period: above the 30 s the worker waits for in-flight jobs on SIGTERM.
FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS for the api: proxies whose X-Forwarded-* headers uvicorn trusts (the infrastructure subnet).
NGINX_REAL_IP_FROM for the frontend: the proxy (CIDR) whose X-Forwarded-For nginx trusts for the client address (the infrastructure subnet, where the ingress runs).
Maximum run time of one migration attempt (seconds).

variables.backendSecrets: [map(variables('backendSecretNames'), lambda('name', createObject('name', lambdaVariables('name'), 'keyVaultUrl', format('{0}{1}', variables('keyVaultSecretsUri'), lambdaVariables('name')), 'identity', resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', parameters('identityName')))))]
variables.otelCollectorConfig:
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318
processors:
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 1s
    limit_percentage: 80
    spike_limit_percentage: 20
  batch: {}
exporters:
  azuremonitor:
    connection_string: ${env:APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
      exporters: [azuremonitor]
